wilderness.biome.desert.desc.0: The dunes of {biome} stretch to the horizon, and the wind leaves only drifting sand ridges behind.
wilderness.biome.desert.desc.1: In {biome}, sunlight bleaches the rocks white and the spirit qi is thin and dry.
wilderness.biome.desert.desc.2: A faint trickling comes from beneath the sand; {biome} is never quiet.
wilderness.biome.desert.name: Quicksand Desert
wilderness.biome.forest.desc.0: The canopy of {biome} blocks the daylight, and only scattered green lights drift among the branches.
wilderness.biome.forest.desc.1: In {biome}, twisted roots form the paths; one wrong step and you loop back to where you started.
wilderness.biome.forest.desc.2: The spirit qi of {biome} carries the bitter freshness of plants; one deep breath clears your mind.
wilderness.biome.forest.name: Gloomy Deepwood
wilderness.biome.marsh.desc.0: Miasma rolls low across {biome}, and the mud underfoot bubbles.
wilderness.biome.marsh.desc.1: Not even birds sing in {biome}; only the sound of bursting bubbles.
wilderness.biome.marsh.desc.2: The deeper you go into {biome}, the thicker the air, and the spirit qi reeks of rot.
wilderness.biome.marsh.name: Nether Marsh
wilderness.biome.plain.desc.0: {biome} spreads out beneath your feet, and patches of Spirit Herbs roll with the terrain.
wilderness.biome.plain.desc.1: The spirit qi in {biome} is mild and even, a rare comfortable stretch for travel.
wilderness.biome.plain.desc.2: The wind sweeps through {biome}, pressing ripples into the grass.
wilderness.biome.plain.name: Spirit Field Plains
wilderness.biome.snow.desc.0: The year-round snow of {biome} reflects the sunlight until it stings, and the wind carries ice shards.
wilderness.biome.snow.desc.1: The snow of {biome} is so smooth it seems endless; only the trail of footprints you left marks it.
wilderness.biome.snow.desc.2: Chill seeps up from beneath {biome}, and the spirit qi freezes brittle.
wilderness.biome.snow.name: Frost Snowfield
wilderness.biome.volcano.desc.0: Dark red light glows through the cracks of {biome}, and the air warps with heat.
wilderness.biome.volcano.desc.1: You walk on the cooled, cracked lava crust of {biome}, and every step crunches loudly.
wilderness.biome.volcano.desc.2: The spirit qi of {biome} burns hot, and every breath tastes of sulfur.
wilderness.biome.volcano.name: Crimson Flame Volcano
